# Knowledge publication boundaries

- Run `python scripts/check_knowledge_publication.py --history-scope stability` and the integration pytest for the fixed72 independent audit questions plus8 adjacent context controls. Preserve all original labels. New assignment/calculation/comparison and planned timing must survive record-reading normalization; completed reports, explicit exclusions and copy destinations cannot hide an independent request. Keep all older744 contracts as a separate gate.

- Follow `docs/planning/knowledge-publication-20261021.plan.md` and `docs/failures/knowledge-publication-integrity.md`.
- Review approval, quality approval, embedding completion and search visibility are separate. Schema-valid placeholders and unstructured logs cannot pass quality review.
- Preserve source work logs, draft cards, query-time evidence and review audit history. Derive asset bindings from the original incident, never from the currently selected installation.
- Publish card, chunks, vectors and manifest in one SQLite transaction. Before committing network results, recheck review revision, content hash and attempt ID. A superseded result must not resurrect a card.
- Keep embedding network calls outside `MesService._lock`. Failed jobs must remain durable and retry after restart; never mark them searchable to hide a failure.
- `shiftlink/rag/embedding.py` owns document/query prefixes. The published model must match S30h's index model and dimension. A model change requires re-embedding; do not relabel old vectors.
- Create per-query index views. Do not mutate a running pipeline's shared rows/vectors/cards. Validate the publication ticket again under the final query-save lock.
- Field cards are scoped to their original assets and verified conditions. Judge rejection still means no answer. Retrieval availability does not prove equipment safety or factual correctness.
- Run `python scripts/check_knowledge_publication.py` before finishing. It also parses staged Python blobs, since passing tests on a dirty worktree does not prove the staged commit is valid. Do not stage filtered zero-context patches from a dirty file.
- Run publication unit/HTTP/S30h tests and the real-browser test; preserve evidence for failures and fixes. Live-model checks are opt-in and must be reported separately from deterministic model fixtures.
- Do not start/restart a Jetson service, edit the static KB/index, or download models as part of a local test.
- For history routing or its verifier, run both `python scripts/check_knowledge_publication.py --history-scope full` and `python -m pytest tests/history_scope_challenge.py -q -s`. These strict diagnostics fail on any semantic mismatch, including a documented defect; report their exit codes and distinct failing question IDs. Never replace semantic assertions with observation-only assertions, xfail, or success because a failure is known. The default metadata gate and harness self-tests do not certify application semantics. The publication workflow also runs the strict fixture challenge and residual-scope regressions; their success does not prove live-model quality.
- Keep explicit expected history/current oracles and reasons in `tests/fixtures/field_history_scope_cases.json`; ambiguous completed-today judgements are outside its scored cases. Minimal is a smoke profile, full is a finite family matrix, and adversarial checks verifier sensitivity. Count mutant kills only with an oracle-correct control or an unchanged baseline-PASS witness. Keep card/source preservation, prompt transfer, semantic outcomes and setup failures separate; fixtures do not prove live model quality or future equipment safety.

- Historical command mentions require explicit completed-report, reference or exclusion scope. Do not erase an independent request following that scope. For `해줘서`, exempt only a completed causal clause; polite, obligation and causative action requests must still reach judgement. Residual-scope tests check original card/work-log data, an earlier persisted query and the new saved answer separately.

- Main/local integration must run `python scripts/check_knowledge_publication.py --history-scope integration` and `python -m pytest tests/test_field_history_integration.py -q -s`. Keep the fixed 283 questions and explicit oracles. Treat MAIN current-request preservation (158) and existing local historical raw-answer preservation (95) as independent acceptance gates; a higher total never offsets either regression. Only clearly completed history may bypass the normal judgement path; uncertain scope must keep the full original request and MES context. Preserve prior reports and the original thirty-question fixture.
- Keep cross-lens and judge cases in `tests/fixtures/field_history_integration_novel_cases.json` separate from the fixed MAIN comparison. Inspect every remaining independent clause after local completed/reference/exclusion removal; a later past clause cannot hide an earlier command. Run existing boundary/intent/request/residual tests too: a new corpus passing cannot excuse an older failing contract. One ambiguous same-command withdrawal stays in the audit evidence, outside the firm scored fixtures. Never infer an oracle from the classifier's result.
- Run `python scripts/check_knowledge_publication.py --history-scope reaudit` and the integration pytest module for the fixed 150 audit questions in `tests/fixtures/field_history_reaudit_cases.json`. Keep all four target families (23 retrieval, 2 completed report, 1 exclusion particle, 4 live exclusion) and the 13 shared gaps strict. MAIN's 73 additional active requests, ce1's 44 successful raw histories and the original 512 contracts are separate preservation gates. Exclusions must apply only to their own object; never erase a preceding request. Read-only confirmation/capability questions about recorded fields differ from present equipment judgement. Preserve completed speech content and its time modifier together.
- Run `python scripts/check_knowledge_publication.py --history-scope postaudit` for the six independent audits' 76 preregistered questions. Keep their original oracles and source attribution in `tests/fixtures/field_history_post67_cases.json`; the integration service test exercises them alongside all older cohorts. A new analysis request remains on the MES/model path even when expressed using a record-reading verb; capability normalization requires an explicitly recorded reading object. Preserve failed intermediate subjects and distinguish an existing shared gap from a newly introduced regression.
